title: Data Leakage to External Systems
description: The assignment & grading service (P2) may expose sensitive student data (student id, course, file reference) to unauthorized external systems or third parties.
assumptions: The service does not implement proper data encryption or access controls for external access.

title: Data Duplication
description: The assignment & grading service (P2) may duplicate student data (student id, course, file reference) across multiple systems or backups, increasing the risk of exposure.
assumptions: The service does not have a centralized data retention policy or audit trail for data duplication.

title: Uncertainty in Access Control

title: Assignment File Exposure

This action exposes the teacher's identity and potentially their personal information (e.g., name, email, student ID) to the Grades Portal Web App (P1) if the system does not properly mask or anonymize this data during the request.

title: Teacher's Access to Personal Data

title: Teacher's Request for Data

title: Teacher's Unintended Data Exposure

This could happen if the system does not properly validate the request or if the teacher's credentials are compromised.

title: Teacher's Non-Compliance
